text.p: Futures slipped in line with Spain but the cash market remained well supprted, helped by the slight recovery of the escudo, even if volumes were very thin.
The trend will remain dependent on what happens in Spain and above all on how the market views Italy's chances of qualifying for monetary union, traders said.
Volumes on the cash market should improve from next week with the return to trade of four benchmark bonds suspended this week for the payment of coupons.
The escudo ended at 100.43/46 to the mark against 100.50/55 at Thursday's close. --Lisbon bureau 3511-3150035
